note: Public datasets mapped onto docs/label-taxonomy.json. 'contains' tokens are matched (lowercase) against the folder path of each image, first rule wins; unmatched folders are skipped. VERIFY each dataset's licence on its download page before using it, and keep citations for the research report. Run prepare_data.py --dry-run first to check the folder-to-label mapping.

sources.title: KaraAgro AI Maize Dataset (Makerere AI Lab and partners)
sources.get: Search 'KaraAgro AI Maize Dataset' on Harvard Dataverse, download, extract into data/raw/karaagro_maize/

sources.title: Labeled dataset of healthy and diseased maize from Tanzania (NM-AIST, TARI)
Cassava leaf images, Uganda (Makerere AI Lab / NaCRRI, iCassava 2019), folder layout
sources.get: Download from the iCassava 2019 repository (links on the competition page) and extract into data/raw/cassava_uganda/ (one folder per class)

sources.title: Cassava Leaf Disease Classification (Kaggle), CSV layout. Use this OR cassava_uganda, not both
sources.get: Download the Kaggle competition data into data/raw/cassava_kaggle/ (train.csv + train_images/). Check label_num_to_disease_map.json: the values below assume 3 = mosaic, 4 = healthy
